title: Drug KEEPER™ Storage Cabinets
meta_title: Drug KEEPER™ Storage Cabinets - Safe Storage for Hazardous Chemicals
meta_description: Drug KEEPER™ storage cabinets offer an economical solution for safe short-term storage of confiscated hazardous chemicals and illegal drugs. Protect users with advanced filtration and airflow monitoring.
meta_keywords: drug storage cabinet, hazardous chemical storage, forensic lab equipment, law enforcement storage, ductless cabinet
short_description: Drug KEEPER™ storage cabinets can be used for short-term storage of hazardous chemicals and substances typically associated with drug investigations.
full_description:
The ductless Drugkeeper storage cabinet is self-contained and does not require venting to the outside. Many units are portable and may be moved with minimal downtime and without filter changes. Set-up, operation and filter maintenance are straightforward. Because filtered air is returned to the room, no demands are required of the facility HVAC capacity for make-up air.
Drugkeeper special purpose storage cabinets offer an economical solution for safe storage of confiscated hazardous chemicals and illegal drugs. Cabinet airflow and face velocity protect users from incidental exposures while electronic airflow monitoring assures continuous safety. Activated carbon main filters are formulated for general purpose storage; optional HEPA filters eliminate exposure to biological particulates. Air Science ductless technology combined with innovative filtration technology creates a safe work environment over a wide range of applications.
seo_content: Drugkeeper storage cabinets are designed for use in state and federal crime laboratories, medical examiners and coroners offices, forensics labs, law enforcement agencies, hospital emergency rooms, and drug agencies. The cabinets feature advanced filtration and airflow monitoring to protect users from hazardous chemical and drug exposures.

Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. This product may assist you with compliance or as part of your chemical hygiene plan. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
